The <b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is one of sixteen(16) different [[Fishing|fish]] that can be caught, and either sold to the [[Lighthouse Keeper]] or processed for [[cooking]]. The difficulty in catching it is relatively low, thus it's thought to be a relatively low-tier fish.

== Fishing ==
The odds of catching a fish are affected by other fish in the area.  More competition means your chance of catching a particular fish over another is lowered. Listed below is a table of a fish's bait preferences, fishing and casting location, type of rod, and time of day. If a method isn't listed below it's impossible to catch this fish using it.
